footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Kingsway: includes a $3.8M income tax benefit, $10.2M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests; after $11.9M of preferred dividends. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 23.4% to $135M in 2025. Gross margin was 62.6%, versus 65.5% a year earlier, and the company had an operating loss of $2.4M, versus operating income of $2.2M.
The net loss widened to $11.9M, or −$0.43 per share, from $9.5M. Operating cash flow was −$3K and free cash flow −$3K, versus $1.1M; Kingsway returned $345K through buybacks.
sources: Kingsway Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
